palette.primary_role: Black and white are the core binary. Figma uses ONLY #000000 and #ffffff for all interface chrome — color comes from product content. Framer uses pure black (#000000) as a void canvas. Creative/Artistic use near-black (#111827) for text on white.
palette.accent_role: Single electric accent for interactive highlights. Framer Blue (#0099ff) is the sole accent in an otherwise monochrome system. Creative uses vibrant blue (#3b82f6) and purple (#8b5cf6) for playful emphasis. The accent is always a tool/creative color — blue, purple, or teal.
palette.surface_role: Pure white or pure black surfaces. Framer uses frosted glass effects (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) on dark. Figma uses monochrome exclusively. Creative/Artistic use white cards on white backgrounds.
palette.neutral_role: Muted silvers and grays for secondary text on dark surfaces. Ghost white (rgba(255,255,255,0.6)) for tertiary text on black. Always cool-toned — never warm grays in creative tool brands.
palette.border_role: Minimal borders. Framer uses blue ring shadows as borders. Figma uses near-invisible separators. Creative/Artistic use standard hairline borders.

border_radius.pill: 50px - 100px (all buttons, CTAs, tabs — creative tools love the pill)
border_radius.typical_button: 50px (Figma) to 100px (Framer) — always full pill or close to it

button_styles.text: Get started, Try free, Start designing, Sign up

elevation.shadows: whisper to blue-tinted ring shadows — creative brands treat shadows as design elements
elevation.approach: Figma uses minimal shadow — depth from monochrome contrast. Framer uses blue ring shadows (rgba(0,153,255,0.15) 0px 0px 0px 1px) as a signature border-replacement. Creative/Artistic use standard surface shadows sparingly.

typical_order: header (sticky, dark or white, logo left, product tabs center, CTA pill right)
hero (full-width gradient or dark void, massive display headline with extreme negative tracking, product screenshot as hero art, primary pill CTA)
product_tabs (horizontal pill tabs for product areas — 'Design', 'Prototype', 'Develop', 'Publish')
features (alternating text+screenshot sections, each product area as its own 'exhibit')
product_showcase (full-width embedded product screenshots/demos with subtle shadows, the tool markets itself)
customer_logos (creative teams and companies who use the tool)
testimonials (designer quotes, often with work examples)
cta (dark full-width section, bold headline, primary pill button)
footer (clean multi-column, dark bg, minimal decoration)
hero_variants: gradient_explosion (Figma style — vibrant multi-color gradient bg, 86px figmaSans weight 400, -1.72px tracking, white text)
void_dark (Framer style — pure black #000000 canvas, 110px GT Walsheim weight 500, -5.5px extreme tracking, product screenshots as hero)
playful_bold (Creative style — bright colors, Bangers display font, character-driven illustrations)
high_contrast_artistic (Artistic style — Limelight display, bold color choices, striking visual presence)
feature_card_variants: product_screenshot_card (embedded UI screenshot in card, subtle shadow, dark bg, pill button)
monochrome_card (white bg, black text, 8px radius, minimal decoration — Figma style)
blue_ring_card (dark bg, blue ring shadow border, frosted elements — Framer style)
playful_card (colorful accents, expressive typography, bold borders — Creative/Artistic style)

tone_profile.headline_style: bold declarations, compressed and kinetic, 3-6 words (e.g., 'Where design happens', 'Design, publish, and scale', 'Nothing great is made alone')
tone_profile.cta_style: invitation to create (Start designing, Try free, Get started, Explore — creative tools invite, never demand)
trust_signals: used-by design teams at top companies
anti_patterns: stock photography instead of product screenshots
no product demo above the fold
complex navigation that buries the product

color_mood: monochrome_gallery (Figma: #000000 + #ffffff only for interface, color from product content — tool as gallery wall)
void_blue (Framer: #000000 pure black canvas, #0099ff electric accent, white frosted glass — nightclub for designers)
playful_vibrant (Creative: #3b82f6 blue + #8b5cf6 purple, Bangers display font, character-driven — fun creative energy)
bold_artistic (Artistic: high-contrast, Limelight display, bold palette, striking visuals)
typography_mood: variable_precision (Figma: figmaSans at weights 320/330/340/450/480/540/700 — micro-weight control only designers would notice)
compressed_cinematic (Framer: GT Walsheim at -5.5px tracking, 0.85 line-height, OpenType maximalism — spring-loaded headlines)
expressive_playful (Creative: Bangers display at large sizes, fun personality)
layout_density: gallery_spacing (Figma: each product section breathes as its own exhibit, generous whitespace, colorful sections as visual relief)
dark_void (Framer: black background means whitespace manifests as void, dramatic pauses, dense-within-spacious-between)
compact_creative (Creative/Artistic: tighter spacing, more visual density, bold graphics filling available space)

pricing_page.best_practices: 3-tier with free tier prominently featured, monthly/yearly toggle, team/enterprise options, feature comparison table

portfolio_page.best_practices: Full-bleed work examples, minimal text, let the work speak, bold typography for project names, dark or white canvas

docs_page.best_practices: Clean typography, code examples in mono, interactive demos where possible, figmaMono or Azeret Mono for labels
